Taichi: "My dear, you have quite the willpower y-e-s!"

rows.jp: 「これをやると言ってるんだ」

rows.en: “Like hell it is! That’s a sandwich!”

rows.en: “See? You do know what it is.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "So you do know don't you."

rows.jp: 「飢えてるからそんなフラフラしてるんだろうに」

ghs.en: Taichi: "That wobbly unsteadiness of yours is probably 'cause you're starving yourself."

ghs.remedy: She turns away.

highlights.text: Uncooperative.

rows.jp: 「こんなことになったからって、幸せっぽくても、いいじゃん？」
rows.en: “Just because all this happened doesn't mean you can't be a little happy, does it?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "And because of all that's happened here, can't you just sort of be happy, or something?"
ghs.assessment: Taichi says that even though this situation has occurred, it should be permissible for her to appear happy. The English makes the situation a cause and directly demands happiness.

rows.jp: 「何言ってるのかわからない」
rows.en: “I have no idea what you’re talking about.”

ghs.en: Touko: "What's that even mean I don't know."

rows.jp: 今度は、全然痛くなかった。
rows.en: This one barely hurt at all.

ghs.en: This time, it did not hurt in the slightest.

rows.jp: 攻撃したあと、へたりこんでいた。
rows.en: After striking me, she slumped to the floor.

ghs.en: Right after this strike, Touko collapses sitting on to the floor.
ghs.assessment: The construction combines incompatible motion and posture verbs and uses 'on to' incorrectly.
ghs.remedy: sinks down onto the floor

highlights.text: collapses sitting on to the floor

rows.jp: 目頭を押さえて、青い顔をしている。
rows.en: She pressed the corner of one eye, her face bloodless.

ghs.en: Holding her eyes shut, her face almost colorless.
ghs.assessment: Touko presses the inner corners of her eyes while pale and faint. The English instead says she closes and holds both eyes shut.
ghs.remedy: Pressing the inner corners of her eyes

highlights.text: Holding her eyes shut

ghs.en: Touko: "Don't address me without honorifics, you..."
So she says as if squeezing it out.

rows.jp: 一瞬で、額に汗が浮いていた。
rows.en: In an instant, sweat beaded across her forehead.

ghs.en: In that moment, sweat surfaces on her forehead.

rows.jp: 「こんな状況なんだぞ。休戦だ休戦」
rows.en: “Look at the situation we’re in. Truce. We’re calling a truce.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Don't try it when you're like this. Truce, we're in a truce."
ghs.assessment: Taichi points to the extraordinary situation they all share and declares a truce. The English adds a command not to attempt an unspecified act in her present condition.
ghs.remedy: We're in a situation like this. Truce, truce.

highlights.text: Don't try it when you're like this.

rows.jp: もう医者はいないのだから。

ghs.en: Because there are no doctors anymore, now.

rows.en: Could malnutrition make you go blind?

ghs.assessment: The narrator himself shudders at the possibility of blindness. The English transfers the reaction to Touko.
ghs.remedy: I shudder.

highlights.text: She's shivering.

rows.jp: 「他には？　他に調子悪いところは？」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Anything else? Is there any other problem healthwise?"

rows.jp: 「気持ち悪い。ふらふらする……吐きそう」
rows.en: “I feel sick. Dizzy... like I'm going to throw up.”

ghs.en: Touko: "I feel nauseous. I feel dizzy... like to throw up."
ghs.assessment: Touko feels as though she is about to vomit. 'Like to' normally expresses preference or desire.
ghs.remedy: like I'm going to throw up

highlights.text: like to throw up

rows.en: I motioned for her to lie down.

ghs.assessment: The Japanese says the narrator urges her to lie down. The English supplies only an adverb, omitting both actor and action.
ghs.remedy: I urge her.

highlights.text: Urgently.

rows.jp: 冬子は抵抗しなかった。

rows.en: Blindness... but this had come on awfully fast.

ghs.en: Loss of eyesight... but it's kinda sudden for that, isn't it.

rows.en: Even if it was blindness, that was still better than a serious illness or a major internal injury.

ghs.en: Assuming it is for the moment, anything is preferable to serious illnesses or external damage that reaches internal organs.
ghs.assessment: The narrator says that even if it is blindness, that is better than a grave disease or organ-threatening injury. The English adds a temporary assumption and claims anything at all is preferable.
ghs.remedy: Even if it is blindness, that's better than a grave illness or an injury reaching her organs.

highlights.text: Assuming it is for the moment, anything is preferable

rows.jp: 「冷静にな。パニックになることはない」
rows.en: “Stay calm. There’s no reason to panic.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Stay composed now. It's not something to panic over."

rows.en: “Has anything else felt wrong these past few days?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Anything out of the ordinary physically in the last few days?"

rows.en: “Did anything caustic splash into your eyes?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Did you get some powerful medicine or something poisonous on the eyes?"

rows.en: So it really had come on all at once.

ghs.en: Really all of a sudden then.

rows.jp: 「ちょっと見えるようになってきた」

ghs.en: Touko: "I think I'm starting to see something now."
Taichi: "Then this was just anemia, maybe."

rows.en: “Anemia can do that. It would explain the nausea, too.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "The symptoms seem to be all there. It should also cause your feeling of nausea, you know."
ghs.assessment: Taichi explains that anemia can produce symptoms like temporary darkness and that it also caused the nausea. The English instead says all diagnostic symptoms appear present.
ghs.remedy: Anemia can cause symptoms like that. It's also why you feel nauseous.

highlights.text: The symptoms seem to be all there.

rows.jp: 「……本当に、ちゃんと食べてないから」
rows.en: “...That's what happens when you don't eat properly.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...seriously, it's because you're not eating properly."

rows.en: “...I never have an appetite in summer.”

rows.jp: 「でも貧血が起きるのはまずいよ、先生」
rows.en: “But you can't let yourself get anemic, Professor Kirihara.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "But an attack of anemia is bad, Sensei!"

rows.jp: 「神話の中で、砂と魔女を挟んで食べたのが由来なんだ」
rows.en: “The name comes from an old myth: people ate witches sandwiched between layers of sand.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "According to the legends, it was eaten sandwiched between sand and a witch, and that is the origin of its name."

ghs.en: Touko rubs around her eye sockets.

Taichi: "This is hand-made, I'll have you know."

Touko: "It's too big and hard to eat."
Taichi: "I really like 'em harsh and spicy."

She clapped a hand over her mouth.

ghs.en: Taichi: "An essential in a fallen world."

highlights.text: puts it to the mouth

ghs.en: then raises the canteen's butt to the sky.

rows.en: Her throat bobbed as she drank. With gusto.

ghs.en: Her throat giving protuberance as water passes through. Vigorously.

ghs.remedy: Her throat bobs as she drinks deeply.

highlights.text: Her throat giving protuberance as water passes through. Vigorously.

ghs.assessment: Taichi asks whether she is at least taking in fluids. The English presupposes failure and adds a requirement of regularity.
ghs.remedy: You're at least keeping hydrated, right?

highlights.text: you're not replenishing your fluids regularly?

highlights.text: Touko: "Clumsy-chan I'm gonna call ya."

rows.jp: 「店に取りに戻ればいいだろうが」

rows.en: “...Then I’d have to leave another note.”

Touko: "if people were to see it..."

rows.en: All this just to save face?

ghs.en: It's only a question of honor?

ghs.en: She became as if to cry.

highlights.text: the recognition of values like that disappears

それは純粋な個としての人。

ghs.en: That is a person existing in pure Individuality.

ghs.en: All desires are being usurped by the previously scorned wants.

rows.en: I didn't think Touko had it.

ghs.remedy: I don't think Touko has that strength.

highlights.text: I didn't think those wants were in Touko.

ghs.remedy: the terrible extremity of Touko's weakness

highlights.text: Touko's violent weakness

ghs.en: This gal's already at the limit.

rows.en: Humanity gone, her family gone, there she was in that sprawling mansion of a house—

ghs.en: Mankind fallen, her family also gone, and in that enormous castle-like mansion...

rows.en: “From now on, the eight of us have to go on living together.”

rows.jp: 誰にだって、逃れられない死が待ってる。
rows.en: Death waits for everyone. No one escapes it.

ghs.en: Death is an inescapable eventuality for everyone.

rows.jp: 「問題はいつ、どう死ぬかだろ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "The problem is when one dies, and how."

rows.en: “This is... impossible... People can't just... disappear.”

ghs.en: Touko: "This... can't be can it... people are just... not there anymore."

rows.en: I forced her to face it.

rows.jp: 「世界は人を塗りつぶした。俺たちだけが、『互い』だ」
rows.en: “The world has painted everyone else out. Now we’re all each other has.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "This world has painted out all people. We alone are... reciprocal."

rows.jp: 仕方、ないのかもしれない。
rows.en: Maybe there was no avoiding it.
I had gotten involved. Of my own free will.

ghs.en: There was involvement. A wish for it.

rows.jp: 俺が冬子と築きたかった関係は、決して蜂蜜のようなそれではなかったけれど。
rows.en: The relationship I wanted with Touko was never going to be honey-sweet.

ghs.en: The relationship I wanted to build with Touko was never to be in any way similar to honey, but...

ghs.en: ...the choice to abandon this broken girl to herself will never appear.

rows.en: Up to a point, that was fine.

ghs.en: Up to partway through it's fine.

rows.en: But once we reached the end of the line?

ghs.en: But... what about the very final part?

rows.jp: もう逃げ場はないに違いない。
rows.en: There would be nowhere left to run.

ghs.en: There are no more places to escape to, no mistake.

highlights.text: even if nothing is there but Downfall

highlights.text: Taichi: "...whatever I do, what?"

rows.jp: サンドイッチを囓りながら冬子。
